sloka: साम्प्रतं सुसमृद्धार्थं समित्रगणबान्धवम् ।समीक्ष्य विजितारिं त्वां मम प्रीतिरनुत्तमा ।। ६.१२७.८ ।।
transliteration: sāmprataṁ susamṛddhārthaṁ samitragaṇabāndhavam ।samīkṣya vijitāriṁ tvāṁ mama prītiranuttamā ।। 6.127.8 ।।

translations.english: "I am happy to see you coming to me, who have completed the task and won the enemies and after successful completion, you are meeting relatives and friends."
